entities.summary: Gustavo Javier Barrera Castro, commonly known as Panchi Barrera is an Uruguayan-Spanish professional basketball player. His jersey's number is 9. He is a longtime member of the Uruguay national basketball team and is currently playing professionally with Club Atlético Olimpia of Liga Uruguaya de Basketball.
